texts: The Stilllight Station is the lantern-station at the Sunken Cove.
The Stilllight Station is a demanding station.
Every Keeper fears the Stilllight Station.

fields.sentence: The Stilllight Station is the lantern-station at the Sunken Cove.

q2_gaps: equative / specificational copula with a DEFINITE predicate nominal ("X is THE N at Y") — the instruction set only covers "X is a/an N" and "X is ADJ", so there is no carrier for the uniqueness/identity the definite article asserts; the parse can only type the subject and attach the PP
review.notes: Name handling, the name-internal kind atoms (station, cove), the lantern_station genus with the noun modifier left unexposed, and "at" routed to entity-attached LocatedIn are all per doctrine.

fields.sentence: The Stilllight Station is a demanding station.

review.notes: The multi-word name is one opaque symbol with its single Name atom, and the kind word inside the name (also the copular complement) licenses (Member stilllight_station station) with no modifier genus. The evaluative adjective 'demanding' correctly stays its own Member atom rather than fusing into a compound kind.

fields.sentence: Every Keeper fears the Stilllight Station.

review.notes: Universal-over-kind verbal rule at 1.0/0.9 with the "every" QuantifierPhrase companion, Experiencer/Stimulus for the stative psych verb, and the multi-word name typed by the kind word inside it all match the instruction set. Capitalized "Keeper" correctly stays a common-noun kind with no Name atom.
